shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Separate the dialog from the dimmed work area.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Float toast feedback over the work area.

motion.name: route-loading
motion.value: GSAP animates the Trace Loop dot and indeterminate track in 1.1-second cycles above table or form skeletons.

motion.name: page-entry
motion.value: GSAP draws the trace over 460ms and settles the endpoint over 180ms with 80ms overlap.
motion.purpose: Orient the user when a page opens.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.value: Anime.js returns activated control brightness to 100% over 180ms.
motion.purpose: Confirm the action without moving the control.

motion.name: toast-entry
motion.value: Anime.js animates entry for 220ms with a 10px offset.
motion.purpose: Bring attention to feedback without shifting content.

motion.name: task-dialog
motion.value: The backdrop fades over 180ms. The dialog settles 8px over 220ms.
motion.purpose: Keep the task form grounded in the current workspace.

motion.name: support-reveal
motion.value: AOS triggers one 320ms animation on a supporting panel per page.
motion.purpose: Introduce supporting context when the panel enters the viewport.

motion.name: context-navigation
motion.value: Manual Swiper controls at 320ms and zero duration for reduced motion.

narrative.northStar: A calm, dependable accounting operations console.
narrative.overview: Ledger Editorial brings the daily work queue, its assignees and deadlines into the first viewport. A Gunmetal sidebar frames an Alabaster canvas. A tinted queue header leads into ruled tables, tabular amounts, and compact operational panels.
keyCharacteristics: Gunmetal navigation, Ocean Mist actions and Tuscan Sun attention

rules.name: Queue first
rules.body: Keep the daily work queue ahead of supporting metrics.

rules.name: Ledger Editorial
rules.body: Gunmetal (#393e41) is the navigation and reading ink. Alabaster Grey (#e7e5df) is the canvas and Dust Grey (#d3d0cb) defines panel and table rules. Ocean Mist (#44bba4) identifies primary actions and the selected navigation icon. Deep teal (#205e52) carries links and focus indicators on paper. Tuscan Sun (#e7bb41) draws attention to exceptions. Use a text label for each status and reserve red for errors.

rules.name: Accessible bar charts
rules.body: Use lazy-loaded Chart.js bar charts through react-chartjs-2, with accessible expandable data tables so values are available without relying on the canvas, color, or hover.

rules.name: Actual versus baseline
rules.body: Actual versus baseline bar charts use Gunmetal for actual and Ocean Mist for baseline, with explicit series labels and monthly/YTD modes.

rules.name: Signed contributors
rules.body: Contributor charts use signed horizontal bars around zero to distinguish positive and negative contributions; preserve signs and values in the expandable data table.

rules.name: Capacity is progress
rules.body: Capacity tracks are progress indicators, not Chart.js charts.

rules.name: Source visible
rules.body: Make provenance and simulation status visible.

rules.name: Control and panel tokens
rules.body: Use 9px control, 14px panel, and 18px overlay radii with a 20px panel gap.

rules.name: Potlab Icons
rules.body: Use local Potlab SVG shapes through the shared Icon component. Keep direction cues on hover and keyboard focus.

rules.name: Respect motion preference
rules.body: Disable nonessential motion when reduced motion is requested.

dos: Keep the work queue as the first dashboard module.
Show data period and simulation status.
donts: Use sparkle motifs or decorative icon grids.
Use checkmarks outside successful, validated, or completed states.
